hassio_confirm.title: Busclear add-on found
hassio_confirm.description: Set up the Busclear add-on as a device? It then provides sensors, the recording switch, event entities, device triggers and conditions, services, diagnostics and repairs. The add-on stops announcing the same entities over MQTT while the integration is set up.

manual.title: KNX box or container
manual.description: Busclear on a KNX box or in a Docker container. The box shows the pairing link under /pair as QR code and text: tick "Manage" there, Home Assistant needs a device with admin rights. Without the box's own certificate the connection is not encrypted.

data.address: Address of the KNX box or container

data_description.address: For example knx-box.local or 192.168.1.20:8765. Leave empty to use the address from the link.

error.cannot_connect: The Busclear add-on does not answer. Is it running?
error.invalid_link: That is not a pairing link of the box (knxmonitor://box?…&key=…), or the address is not valid.
error.box_unreachable: Box not reachable. Check the address and whether the box allows access from the network.
error.invalid_auth: Link invalid or device revoked. The device needs admin rights ("Manage" on /pair), and the box must allow access from the network.
error.tls_mismatch: Certificate does not match the link. Pair again on /pair and use the new link.

abort.addon_required: Busclear is set up through its add-on: install and start the Busclear add-on, then Home Assistant offers the integration by itself.
abort.not_knx_monitor_addon: Another add-on announced itself as Busclear and was ignored. Only the Busclear add-on can set up this integration.

not_loaded.message: Busclear is not set up or the add-on is not running.

export_too_large.message: The export was aborted because it is larger than {limit} MB. Export fewer days instead of everything.

export_running.message: An export of the Busclear history is already running. Wait until it has finished.

bus_disconnected.title: KNX bus not connected
bus_disconnected.description: The Busclear add-on has had no bus connection since {since}, so nothing is being recorded. Check the gateway or the connection in the add-on (Busclear in the sidebar).

low_space.title: Busclear: recording paused, disk full
low_space.description: The disk is almost full. The add-on already removed the oldest days and has paused the recording. Free up space or shorten the retention in Busclear; the recording continues by itself.

confirm.title: {label} stopped sending
confirm.description: Usually sends about every {interval}, last at {last}. Check the device and bus voltage, or ignore the address. Once it sends again, this repair goes away by itself.

error.cannot_connect: Busclear does not answer. Try again later.

abort.not_loaded: Busclear is not set up or not running.

confirm.title: {count} addresses stopped sending

error.cannot_connect: Busclear does not answer. Try again later.

abort.not_loaded: Busclear is not set up or not running.

create_report.name: Create report
create_report.description: Creates the installation report of the Busclear add-on now and returns it.

export_history.name: Export history
export_history.description: Saves the history of the Busclear add-on as ETS group monitor file in the folder knx_monitor of the configuration. SpectrumKNX and the ETS read it.

days.name: Days
days.description: Today and the days before it, at most 31.

everything.name: Everything
everything.description: The whole history as zip with one file per day, instead of the days above.
